title.en: Methodical and empowering coaching by Dominik

text.en: Clients describe trainer Dominik Feichtner as clear, insightful, and remarkably calming for both pets and their owners. Reviewers appreciate that he takes time to explain the psychology behind canine behaviors, coaching owners through actionable steps so they feel confident implementing structure and leadership at home.

title.en: Rapid progress with urban leash manners

text.en: Dog owners report dramatic transformations in their pets' daily behavior, often within just two sessions. Clients highlight major improvements in loose-leash walking, elevator etiquette, crate routines, and impulse control, allowing reactive dogs to pass urban distractions in New York City without fixating or barking.

Reviewers emphasize how effectively Dominik works with challenging working breeds like Vizslas, Australian Shepherds, and Dalmatians. By introducing balanced tools and clear boundaries, he helps overwrought, highly reactive dogs relax, regulate their emotions, and gain confidence in bustling environments.

q.en: Does Dominik work with puppy foundations?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently enroll young puppies for comprehensive packages covering crate training, potty routines, and foundational leash manners.

q.en: Can this training help reactive dogs in NYC apartments?

a.en: Yes, reviewers specifically note dramatic progress in managing elevator triggers, hallway encounters, and busy city street distractions.

q.en: What training methodology does he utilize?

a.en: Dominik applies a balanced, common-sense approach that combines clear boundaries, owner coaching, and structured communication tools.
